releaseNote:
修复 Windows 绿色版 C++20 自检缺少 bits/error_constants.h，自动修正受管工具链路径与编译参数，保留自定义配置。工作区直接受信任，不再进入受限模式；浏览界面双击顶部标签栏空白处会打开新的空白浏览器标签页。

Fixed missing bits/error_constants.h during the Windows portable C++20 self-test. Managed compiler paths and flags are repaired while preserving custom settings. Workspaces are trusted automatically, and double-clicking empty space in the browsing tab bar opens a new blank browser tab.
